mission_check.capability: Learn battle attack value from comparable cartridge turns, including consequential failures
mission_check.learned_authority: Frozen expected-utility-v2 selected the observed best moves in both new captures; no fit or promotion
mission_check.transfer_test: Two different authentic train states and active battlers, but both share training-control-v6-train-02; held-out development unopened
mission_check.cheapest_falsifier: Two bounded timing trials per capture expose unequal candidate timing, tied choices, or no correctable model regret
mission_check.time_box: One session, at most two hours; two captures and four cartridge timing trials
mission_check.stop_condition: No consumed-trial replay, weak same-root fit, development opening, full run, ROM hack, Crystal or GitHub publication

timing_probe.finding: One authentic non-tied choice but no timing mismatch; the selected move knocked out the opponent

timing_mismatch_diagnosis.action_free_observation: The consumed capture starts at full HP with battler_status=2, a nonzero Gen I sleep counter; the distinct timing probe starts awake with battler_status=0
timing_mismatch_diagnosis.code_path: Sleep and other suppressed-turn branches can return before the pre-attack frame callback; the collector then rejects a zero versus positive candidate-frame comparison
timing_mismatch_diagnosis.causal_status: plausible explanation, not confirmed for the five consumed trials because their candidate frame counts were not retained
timing_mismatch_diagnosis.next: Treat sleeping boundaries as a separate no-action/recovery lesson when designing the next curriculum; do not impute attack preferences from a suppressed turn

contrast_probe.finding: The higher displayed-power alternative dealt zero damage in both trials; the frozen model correctly chose the lower-power attack

decision.next: Stop probing nearly identical capture states. Design a small, predeclared training curriculum with differentiated action consequences and separate-lineage held-out comparisons; disclose any teacher-only state interventions.
